Thank you for your consistently courteous service.

I trust you.

My dog ate my shoes laces and the hospital I go are closed so I was worried sick but after I came here he got the treatment he needed and he’s better now. The doctors are so friendly and professional. I definitely recommend this hospital!

Thank you for your continued support.
I feel at ease knowing you've taken such thorough care of me.

We always rely on your clinic for treatment for our 18-year-old senior dog and two mischievous 3-year-old dachshunds. You treat each of them carefully with appropriate treatments, which is a great help. You also treated our dog when he couldn't stand on his hind legs, and now he can walk steadily. We are very grateful. We look forward to your continued care.
They are always so kind and attentive, which makes me feel very at ease!

The doctors were very kind and treated my pet very affectionately during the examination! The clinic was also very clean, and I appreciate that the consultation fee includes daily care such as nail trimming. I will definitely come again!

I visited the clinic because I had some concerns about my cat's breathing and a pre-neutering examination.

The doctor was very kind and answered all my questions accurately and thoroughly.

The clinic was bright and clean, and my cat seemed calm!

Thank you very much!

Besides the treatment itself, I've been greatly helped by your advice on various other matters.

Thank you for your continued support.

I rushed in feeling anxious, but they saw me right away and explained everything clearly, which put my mind at ease.

I look forward to using your services again.

I went to get vaccinated.

They were very kind to me.
For the first time, I had all four of my dogs treated at once for their monthly daily care and heartworm prevention! Thank you as always for your gentle care and thorough explanations!

I recently got a cat and went to get its second vaccination.

I'm very grateful for the extremely kind and attentive service I received.

I've been a patient here ever since I adopted my dog.

The examinations are thorough, and personally, I appreciate that payments are automatically processed through my registered credit card, which reduces the amount of luggage I need to carry. I'll definitely continue using their services in the future.

Dear Kokotaro-sama

Thank you very much for your kind review of our hospital.

We, the entire staff, will continue to strive to be a hospital where you can visit with peace of mind.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any concerns or problems.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

Sangenjaya Animal Hospital (Animal Medical Center Peco)

The staff's service was simply wonderful. I appreciate how kindly and carefully they treated my dog. The clinic was also very clean, which was great. I was also grateful for their service during Golden Week.
They responded courteously to my urgent request. It's reassuring to know they're open on Sundays.
That was quick, which was great!
It was great!

I had used this clinic once before for my previous dog. He fell off the bed and dislocated his leg, and since it was a Sunday, I went there. The X-rays and other tests cost a total of 40,000 yen, but in the end, all they did was wrap the dislocated leg in bandages. He couldn't walk like that, so I removed the bandages as soon as I got home. The treatment just for wrapping the bandages cost 5,000 yen. I was told that surgery would cost 300,000 yen. The next day, Monday, I went to my regular vet, who said that if I was careful about how he walked, it would heal on its own. They said the bone was just going in and out of the correct position. So I didn't have a very good impression of this clinic, but I received a flyer for their grand reopening, and everything was 30% off, so I thought I'd give it a try and called them. The dog I had used there passed away the year before last, and I thought it would be okay to just get a rabies vaccination for my new dog, but they told me there was a 3,000 yen initial consultation fee. There was no mention of that on the flyer. In the end, I realized this clinic is only interested in making money.

I always feel at ease because they explain everything so carefully!

I also appreciate being able to manage my weight and other data through the app. There's no waiting time, and it's relatively easy to get an appointment.

The doctor is trustworthy!
I felt very reassured by the thorough examination.
It's very convenient because it's in my neighborhood, and they're happy to take care of my pet's daily needs and explain everything carefully. The doctor and staff are very kind!

I visited again after they reopened.

The head doctor explained everything in detail, which was great.

I'll definitely visit again!

I visited for a combination vaccine injection.

I had a lot of questions because my dog ​​has had allergic reactions in the past, but they explained the risks thoroughly, and I felt confident entrusting my dog ​​to them.

I was also pleased that they trimmed my dog's nails and shaved the pads of its paws while I was consulting with them.

I received a flyer at home announcing the reopening, so I decided to check it out! My cat isn't used to vets, so I was a little worried, but the doctor and nurses were all very kind, and I was able to have her examined with peace of mind. The inside of the clinic was also clean and cute!

I'm writing this honestly because I don't think I'll be going back.

I went there for about six months, and at the time I thought the doctor and nurses were very kind. However, I switched hospitals because they announced an indefinite closure starting in September 2025.

Since Peco was the first veterinary clinic I went to, I didn't know what other animal hospitals were like, and after switching hospitals, I realized that this place was a rip-off, or rather, I had been taken advantage of.

The hospital was clean, and I liked that I could make reservations through the app and there was no waiting time, but they would make up excuses and ask me to come back next week, and then again the week after, making reservations on the spot. At times, I was going about six times a month.

My rescue dog is six years old, so she's not that young, so I thought it was unavoidable, but I was told she had "tracheal collapse" and was given medication costing 12,000 yen a month.

However, when I went to the emergency room at night and to another hospital, I was told that it wasn't tracheal collapse, but rather an elongated soft palate.

In fact, even after stopping the medication prescribed for tracheal collapse, my dog's breathing didn't become labored.

I understand that doctors are human and misdiagnoses are inevitable, but I felt terrible for giving my dog ​​unnecessary medication every day. He underwent soft palate removal surgery at a different hospital and is now very healthy.

I paid an average of 15,000 to 20,000 yen per visit, four times a month, sometimes six times, so even though he had no chronic illnesses, I paid Peco over 500,000 yen in six months.

I never went to other animal hospitals, so it was an expensive lesson.

I learned after switching hospitals that the 1980 yen re-examination fee, including anal gland expression, paw pad trimming, and nail trimming, plus an additional 880 yen prescription fee if medication is needed, is expensive.

The doctors and staff always greet us with kind smiles, so my axolotl doesn't get scared of the hospital and seems happy to go!

The examinations are thorough, easy to understand, and the staff are very caring, so I trust them completely.

Making appointments is also easy, which is a great help.

Thank you for your continued support!

It's easy to walk from the station, the teachers are kind, and it's very convenient to attend. Reservations and contact via LINE and the app are also very easy to use. Cashless payment is also convenient.
Kind, smart, great professionals work here. I have every appreciation. We thank you for everything on behalf of Ruru.

I visited for the first time because it's close to my house and the facilities are clean.

They answered all my questions clearly, which put me at ease. I'd like to visit regularly!

This was my first visit.
I had many anxieties, but the doctor was very gentle and kind throughout.
I felt very at ease.
Thank you very much.
Thank you very much for your positive review! We will continue to provide courteous and considerate service so that you and your family can use our services with peace of mind.
Thank you for your kind and courteous service!
They were very kind.
The doctors and nurses are very attentive

I felt reassured because they thoroughly researched and answered all my detailed questions about treatment options and costs, and I appreciated their sincere approach. The card payment option was very convenient.

Since it's by appointment only, I'm very grateful that there's no waiting time for my dog's examination! Also, the doctor and staff are all very kind, and their explanations are very thorough, so I feel at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care!
Thank you very much for your positive review! We will continue to provide courteous and considerate service so that you and your family can use our services with peace of mind.
